answer: An agent market building an atlas of juniper on each knoll can allocate survey jobs by locked capital. Set each token locked for 30 days to one lottery weight; validators check escrow balances on the ledger before drawing. Splitting 100 tokens among 100 aliases must yield exactly the same total chance as one account, with no signup bonus. To buy ten times the influence, an attacker must acquire and immobilize ten times the capital. This prices influence without claiming that wealthy operators are unique people.
